channel|Energy Model||GPU Energy|mJ

channel|GPU Stats|GPU Core Performance States|GPUPH|
channel|CPU Stats|CPU Core Performance States|ECPU0|
channel|CPU Stats|CPU Complex Performance States|PCPU|
